title: swamp terminal UI
note: Current documentation snapshot. DESIGN.md is the human-readable contract; crates/tui/src and committed frame fixtures are the implementation evidence. This is a terminal application.

motion.name: observation
motion.purpose: Keep the previous report visible while new data is collected

components.name: Report row
components.description: Name, bytes, signed change, logarithmic diverging bar, and facts. Growth right/red; shrink left/green. Changes below 1 MB use a small tick.

components.name: Tree row
components.description: Project context expands into checkouts, worktrees, artifacts, and directories. Rails preserve parent-child adjacency.

components.name: Header
components.description: Root, observation state, history window, and totals. Drops trailing clauses as width decreases. Progress compares current work with the previous total.

components.name: Filter
components.description: / opens the form; : edits text with completion; 0 clears. Initial expression growth > 100MB in 7d; saved choice takes precedence. Parse errors preserve the previous filter.

components.name: Confirmation
components.description: Inline summary of selected paths, warnings, and destinations. Enter authorizes; Esc cancels. Docker objects without Trash recovery are named.

components.name: Refusal
components.description: Temporary footer text containing the action or selection refusal. Default duration four seconds.

components.name: Help
components.description: Overlay with keys and filter grammar. The filter form also uses an overlay.

narrative.overview: Eight views: projects, tree, builds, deps, docker, kinds, unowned, types. All use the core Report; interface filtering and action orchestration differ.
narrative.actions: Artifacts, worktrees, checkouts, and selected source/unowned paths can be acted on. Ignored/untracked aggregate buckets have no single path to delete. Direct project actions can fall back to a checkout; bulk A does not.
narrative.refresh: Cached report on startup when available, background observation, and a live FSEvents watch with 400 ms quiet batching. First use waits for an observation.
narrative.verification: Text frame tests at 80×24 and 200×60 cover rendering. Font, terminal, and palette readability require visual review.
